verdict.rationale: Team chat is a fair axis for a planning tool, but the evidence shows no built-in chat or real-time messaging in Linear. What it does show is adjacent: inline comments on issue descriptions and code lines, plus Slack integrations that sync threads into a separate chat tool. Neither counts as chatting with the team inside Linear itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in
